correctness.rationale: The entire nonempty 8246-face complex is twice enumerated from the explicit nineteen nine-point residue blocks. A fully checked acyclic matching has 4080 pairs and critical cells in dimensions 0,2,3 only, counted (1,4,81); a complete directed Hasse topological sort checks all 40014 incidences. Exact oriented gradient reduction produces the entire integral 4-by-81 Morse differential. Its row relation (1,-2,-1,1) proves rank at most three, and a rank-three determinant -1 minor gives rank exactly three and three unit Smith invariants. A one-vertex CW model with no 1-cells then has 2-skeleton a four-sphere wedge, and unit attaching maps cancel three 2/3 pairs, leaving S^2 wedge 78 S^3. Independent full mod-two boundary ranks agree, but do not replace the integer homotopy argument.

value.rationale: The Paley (19,9,4) Hadamard incidence design is a distinguished classical symmetric design and the Paley tournament is a canonical doubly regular tournament; no arbitrary slicing was introduced. Its outward-neighborhood complex exhibits both a unique integral two-dimensional class and 78 independent three-dimensional classes, a mixed-dimensional integral homotopy type not supplied by known directed flag, incidence-design, or general Dowker results. The exact finite classification and integral non-torsion result provide a natural reference example for topology of asymmetric relations; no invented broad theorem is required.
